product_family: Full-stack customer engagement and retention platform (Retention OS). Core capabilities: Customer Data Platform, Product & Revenue Analytics, Segmentation, Omnichannel Campaign Manager, Campaign Orchestration, Web Personalization, App Personalization, and Marketing Automation. Not a generative-AI product; personalization/automation is rules- and segmentation-driven rather than LLM-based on the evidence gathered.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: WebEngage undergoes annual third-party audits to ensure our internal controls are designed and operated effectively, following industry standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001:2013 certified ensuring highest data security standards.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center Resources section lists a downloadable 'ISO 27701' compliance document alongside SOC2 Type 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: WebEngage has achieved full HIPAA compliance ... engaged independent third-party auditors for validation and improvement. Uses AES-256 encryption and TLS for data in transit, with role-based access controls.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: WebEngage is GDPR compliant and takes necessary steps to ensure customer privacy.

certifications.name: RBI SAR (India System Audit Report - fintech)
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center lists 'RBI SAR' as 'Compliant' alongside SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, GDPR, HIPAA, and VAPT.

certifications.name: VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing)
certifications.proof_quote: Resources section lists a downloadable 'Vulnerability Assessment Report'; trust center marks VAPT as 'Compliant'.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS on the vendor's trust center, security page, or blog. WebEngage does not process payment card data as part of its core product.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification. Not listed on trust center or security page, and no search result surfaced a vendor announcement.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or certification.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization; WebEngage's stated data centers are US, India, and Saudi Arabia, with no federal-government-specific offering mentioned.

privacy.ai_training_note: No public statement found (privacy policy, terms, security page, or trust center) confirming or denying use of customer data to train AI/ML models. WebEngage's core product is a rules/segmentation-based customer engagement platform rather than a generative-AI product, so this is plausibly not applicable, but it is not explicitly addressed in any vendor-domain document.
privacy.data_region: Default US Data Center, with India Data Center (dashboard.in.webengage.com) and Saudi Arabia Data Center available by contractual agreement.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS protocols with SHA256 algorithms used to handle data communications; HIPAA blog additionally cites TLS for PHI in transit.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for data at rest (stated specifically in the context of HIPAA-scoped PHI; general security page references 'advanced encryption' without naming the algorithm).

security.name: PII masking / hashing
security.value: User contact information can be hashed; PII data can be masked.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control and maker-checker principles available; multi-factor authentication referenced in HIPAA context.

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: All actions taken by an admin, across the dashboard, are logged for auditing.

security.name: Third-party audits
security.value: Annual third-party audits of internal controls following SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards; independent auditors engaged for HIPAA validation (auditor name not disclosed publicly).

products.name: Customer Data Platform
products.data_scope: Consolidates customer data from multiple sources into a unified profile.
products.notes: Core data layer underlying segmentation and personalization features.

products.name: Segmentation & Analytics
products.data_scope: Behavioral and product-usage event data; cohort funnels, paths, RFM modeling.
products.notes: Rules/statistics-based, not described as AI-model-driven in vendor copy captured.

products.name: Omnichannel Campaign Manager / Orchestration
products.data_scope: Customer contact and behavioral-trigger data across email, push, SMS, WhatsApp, and other channels.

products.name: Web & App Personalization
products.data_scope: Behavioral and segmentation data used to customize on-site/in-app experiences.
products.notes: No evidence of generative-AI/LLM component; described as rule- and segment-driven.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription (demo-gated; pricing not publicly listed).
compare.data_residency: US (default), India, or Saudi Arabia data centers, selectable via contract.

flags: AI-training posture is unstated: no vendor-domain source (privacy policy, terms, security page, trust center) explicitly confirms or denies use of customer data for AI/ML model training.

Auditor identity not disclosed: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and HIPAA validation are asserted on vendor pages but the specific accredited auditor/certification body name is not published (the underlying documents are gated behind a request form on the trust center, https://webengage.trust.site/resources).

RBI SAR is an India-specific financial-sector audit standard, listed by the vendor as 'Compliant' but not independently verifiable without the gated document; it should be understood as narrower and regional in scope.
